استبقيا (form X)
# اِسْتَبْقَيَا (istabqayā) /is.tab.qa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَبْقَى (istabqā)
# اُسْتُبْقِيَا (ustubqiyā) /us.tub.qi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَبْقَى (istabqā)
# اِسْتَبْقِيَا (istabqiyā) /is.tab.qi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَبْقَى (istabqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
